resources.string: Discard this local event?\n%1$s\nIf the server already received it, its evidence remains in the inbox.
Suggestions need review. Missing notifications do not mean there were no purchases. SMS must be shared manually.
Upload paused. Renew pairing for this same device in web settings. The queue is preserved.
An event was rejected. Review the queue with support before clearing it; no event was discarded.
Could not capture or upload. Check network and storage, then retry. The existing queue is preserved.
Match the exact app and last four digits to a card. Additional cards may map to the same main account. Without a match, choose the card in the web inbox.
Discard all local pending events? This does not undo purchases or evidence already received by the server.
Manage or revoke device on web
Generate a code in web Settings → Android capture. To keep queued events when reconnecting, renew pairing for the same device. Only use the HTTPS address of your own financial app.
Paired. Select apps and resume capture.
Pairing failed. Verify address and code. If events are queued, renew the same device in web settings and use a new code.
Could not read or save protected data. Do not uninstall or clear app data if you need to recover the queue.
No supported purchase found. Use manual capture in the web inbox. Codes and nonfinancial text are discarded.
Review the extracted suggestion. Only these fields are queued; the shared text is not stored. The web inbox handles duplicates and corrections.
Purchase date and amount meaning need review
